subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word that best fits the gap.

NOTICE
The library will be closed ___ Monday, May 5th, for maintenance.

A. on
B. at
C. in
D. from
explanation: Dùng giới từ 'on' trước ngày trong tuần (on Monday).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the poster and choose the word that best fits the gap.

GRAND OPENING!
Join us ___ Saturday for free samples and big discounts.

A. in
B. on
C. at
D. to
explanation: Dùng 'on' trước ngày trong tuần (on Saturday).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word that best fits the gap.

LOST AND FOUND
A black wallet was found near the canteen. Please ___ the front desk if it is yours.

A. contact to
B. contacting
C. contacts
D. contact
explanation: Câu mệnh lệnh cần động từ nguyên mẫu 'contact'; 'contact' là ngoại động từ nên không dùng 'to'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the advertisement and choose the word that best fits the gap.

MEGA SALE!
All shoes are 20% ___ this weekend only!

A. on
B. out
C. off
D. up
explanation: '20% off' nghĩa là giảm giá 20%.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the announcement and choose the word that best fits the gap.

ANNOUNCEMENT
The flight to Da Nang has been ___ due to bad weather.

A. delayed
B. delaying
C. delay
D. delays
explanation: Câu bị động 'has been + quá khứ phân từ' (has been delayed).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the job advertisement and choose the word that best fits the gap.

JOB VACANCY
We are looking ___ an experienced receptionist to join our hotel team.

A. at
B. for
C. after
D. up
explanation: 'look for' nghĩa là tìm kiếm.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word that best fits the gap.

REMINDER
All students must ___ their ID cards at all times while on campus.

A. wear
B. bring
C. carry
D. hold
explanation: 'carry' nghĩa là mang theo bên mình, phù hợp với ý 'mang theo thẻ căn cước mọi lúc'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the information and choose the word that best fits the gap.

VISITOR INFORMATION
The museum is open daily ___ 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

A. at
B. in
C. from
D. since
explanation: Cấu trúc 'from ... to ...' chỉ khoảng thời gian mở cửa.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word that best fits the gap.

CONCERT RULES
Please turn ___ your mobile phones before the performance begins.

A. off
B. on
C. up
D. down
explanation: 'turn off' nghĩa là tắt (điện thoại).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the notice and choose the word that best fits the gap.

MEETING NOTICE
The staff meeting has been moved ___ 3 p.m. to 4 p.m. this Friday.

A. since
B. from
C. at
D. in
explanation: 'moved from ... to ...' nghĩa là dời từ ... sang ....

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the advertisement and choose the word that best fits the gap.

FOR RENT
A fully ___ apartment with two bedrooms and a balcony, close to the city center.

A. furnish
B. furnishing
C. furniture
D. furnished
explanation: 'fully furnished' nghĩa là được trang bị nội thất đầy đủ (quá khứ phân từ làm tính từ).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the advertisement and choose the word that best fits the gap.

WIN A TRIP TO PHU QUOC!
Simply ___ this form and drop it in the box before June 30.

A. fill up
B. fill off
C. fill over
D. fill in
explanation: 'fill in a form' nghĩa là điền vào mẫu đơn.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Read the weather bulletin and choose the word that best fits the gap.

WEATHER WARNING
Heavy rain ___ expected in central provinces tonight.

A. is
B. are
C. be
D. been
explanation: 'Heavy rain' là danh từ không đếm được, động từ số ít: 'is expected'.

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete letter.

(A) Dear Mr. Nam,
(B) I am writing to apply for the sales assistant position advertised in yesterday's newspaper.
(C) Thank you for your consideration. I look forward to hearing from you soon.
(D) I have three years of experience in retail and good communication skills.

A. A-B-D-C
B. A-B-C-D
C. B-A-D-C
D. A-D-B-C
explanation: Thư xin việc: lời chào (A) → mục đích (B) → kinh nghiệm (D) → cảm ơn và kết thư (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete message.

(A) Hi Mai,
(B) I am having a birthday party at my house this Saturday at 7 p.m.
(C) Let me know if you can come!
(D) There will be music, food and games.

A. A-D-B-C
B. A-B-D-C
C. B-A-C-D
D. A-C-B-D
explanation: Tin nhắn mời: lời chào (A) → thông tin bữa tiệc (B) → chi tiết thêm (D) → mời xác nhận (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete set of instructions.

(A) First, boil 400 ml of water.
(B) Next, put the noodles and the seasoning into a bowl.
(C) Finally, stir well and enjoy your meal.
(D) Then, pour the boiling water into the bowl and cover it for three minutes.

A. A-B-C-D
B. B-A-D-C
C. A-B-D-C
D. A-D-B-C
explanation: Trình tự chỉ dẫn: First (A) → Next (B) → Then (D) → Finally (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete email.

(A) Dear Ms. Hoa,
(B) I would like to order ten desks for our new office.
(C) Best regards, Minh.
(D) Could you please send me a quotation for these products?

A. A-B-C-D
B. A-D-B-C
C. B-A-D-C
D. A-B-D-C
explanation: Email đặt hàng: chào (A) → yêu cầu (B) → hỏi thêm (D) → kết thư (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete set of contest instructions.

(A) Attach a photo of your garden.
(B) Send both documents to our office before June 30.
(C) To enter the contest, fill in the entry form.
(D) Winners will receive a cash prize of two million dong.

A. A-C-B-D
B. C-A-B-D
C. C-B-A-D
D. A-B-C-D
explanation: Các bước dự thi: bắt đầu bằng mục đích (C) → đính kèm ảnh (A) → gửi giấy tờ (B) → phần thưởng (D).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete email.

(A) Thank you for your email.
(B) However, we expect new stock to arrive next week.
(C) I am sorry to inform you that the item you ordered is out of stock.
(D) I will contact you as soon as it arrives.

A. A-B-C-D
B. C-A-B-D
C. A-C-B-D
D. A-C-D-B
explanation: Email phản hồi: cảm ơn (A) → thông tin xấu (C) → giải pháp 'however' (B) → cam kết (D).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete notice.

(A) The school English club meets every Friday afternoon.
(B) New members are always welcome.
(C) For more information, please contact Miss Lan in room 12.
(D) Members practise speaking through games and short plays.

A. A-B-D-C
B. A-D-B-C
C. D-A-B-C
D. A-B-C-D
explanation: Thông báo câu lạc bộ: hoạt động chung (A) → nội dung sinh hoạt (D) → mời tham gia (B) → thông tin liên hệ (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete letter.

(A) Dear Grandma,
(B) How are you? I hope you are well.
(C) I will visit you during the summer holiday.
(D) I got high marks in all my subjects this term.

A. A-B-C-D
B. A-D-B-C
C. A-B-D-C
D. B-A-D-C
explanation: Thư cho bà: chào (A) → hỏi thăm (B) → báo tin tốt (D) → hẹn thăm (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete set of instructions.

(A) Next, dig a hole about 30 cm deep.
(B) First, choose a sunny spot in your garden.
(C) Finally, water the tree every morning.
(D) Then, put the young tree into the hole and cover its roots with soil.

A. B-A-D-C
B. A-B-D-C
C. B-A-C-D
D. A-B-C-D
explanation: Trình tự: First (B) → Next (A) → Then (D) → Finally (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete email.

(A) I would like to book two single rooms from July 1st to July 3rd.
(B) Dear Sir or Madam,
(C) Could you please confirm the price per night?
(D) I look forward to your reply.

A. A-B-C-D
B. B-A-D-C
C. B-C-A-D
D. B-A-C-D
explanation: Email đặt phòng: chào (B) → yêu cầu (A) → hỏi giá (C) → mong hồi âm (D).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete set of instructions.

(A) Next, add 200 ml of milk and some honey.
(B) First, cut two bananas into small pieces.
(C) Finally, serve it in a tall glass with ice.
(D) Then, blend everything for one minute.

A. B-D-A-C
B. B-A-C-D
C. B-A-D-C
D. A-B-D-C
explanation: Trình tự: First (B) → Next (A) → Then (D) → Finally (C).

subject: Tiếng Anh
prompt:
Choose the correct order of the sentences to make a complete message.

(A) Our group will meet at the school library at 3 p.m. tomorrow.
(B) Hi Lan,
(C) Please bring the report we discussed last week.
(D) We need to finish our history project before Friday.

A. B-D-A-C
B. B-A-C-D
C. A-B-D-C
D. B-A-D-C
explanation: Tin nhắn nhóm: chào (B) → hẹn giờ địa điểm (A) → mục tiêu (D) → yêu cầu mang tài liệu (C).
